title: Crossing tournaments are polynomially $\vecχ$-bounded
summary: Given a tournament $T$, Aboulker, Aubian, Charbit, and Lopes (2023) defined its clique number $\vecω(T)$ as the minimum clique number of a backedge graph of $T$, and raised the question: Which classes of tournaments are polynomially $\vecχ$-bounded? Aboulker, Duron, Jacob, Kimbrough, Thomassé, and this work's authors (2026) showed that this holds for classes of tournaments whose arc sets may be written as the union of a bounded number of comparability digraphs. What about classes of tournaments that do not admit such a decomposition? The crossing tournaments of Nguyen, Scott, and Seymour…
